pr.body:
W011 connects authenticated query device identities to exact channel regions and measures FIN crossings from layout geometry. The normal fixture yields MN0=5 and MP0=7; extraction_mismatch retains measured 4 versus source CDL 5. Exact seed coverage, unresolved FIN independence, source/target differences and existing local topology/T05 evidence remain explicit.

Independent implementation review, PM technical receipt and dedicated premerge review report zero remaining must-fix findings. Frozen-source evidence includes Python 3.10/3.12 each 1605 passed, strict typing for 54 modules, build and two isolated installation smokes. PM ran 12 targeted checks; dedicated premerge review ran 15, new geometry/boundary probes and 297 engineering checks. Post-merge combination checks will be recorded on the actual integration version.

This is a bounded synthetic M1 component. Full readback wire is about 136.5 MB and fresh-process peak about 6.984 GiB; heavy checks remain serial. W012 separately tracks capture/wire/reconstruction performance. Complete net/body/model extraction, mandatory checks, baseline/no_change/Stage 6 and production admission remain future scope.
